title: AdPulse
tagline: PySpark campaign analytics — segmentation, A/B testing & BI
highlights: PySpark ELT over 2M synthetic ad-impression rows, quarantining 1.5% dirty records and computing CTR/CPA/ROAS by channel/region/month via Spark SQL.
A/B test validated with a two-proportion z-test — +11.7% conversion lift (p=0.028) — with a chi-square cross-check and power analysis.
Segmented 50K customers via RFM + K-Means (k=3, silhouette 0.45), isolating a 17K Champions cohort ($627 avg LTV).
